notes: Quick summary: ThreadNest is a mid-market SaaS for multi-channel support (email + Zendesk + live chat). Primary ask: high-quality ticket/email summarization and automated tag assignment to drive faster triage and routing. They want macros generated for common resolutions and ability to trigger tool-calls (CRM lookup, billing check) from agent UI. Quote from CTO: "We need summaries that reduce handle time without losing context — 3 sentence canonical + 1 action item is ideal." PO wants strict residency for EU customers and SSO for agents. POC notes: dev-label set shows ~92% tag precision but false positives on billing vs billing-refund intents. Latency target: sub-250ms median for agent assist flow; throughput spikes expected during product launches (up to 3x baseline). Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if burst costs are predictable. Technical ask: show KV cache behavior across threaded conversations and demo Zendesk macro push and Freshdesk webhook compatibility. Current blockers: SAML intermittency, legal residency language, clarify fallback policy when dedicated pool saturated. Linked artifacts above (drive + fireflies).
summary_requirements: Deliver real-time ticket/email summarization (3-sentence canonical + 1 action item), auto-tagging into Zendesk fields with >90% precision, ability to push macros and trigger tool-calls, guarantee median latency <250ms for agent flows, predictable burst pricing (up to 3x). Must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, and EU data residency for customer subset.
